_doc: The common lever microswitch endstop marked 10T85, body about 20 x 10 x 6 mm (KW12-3 and its twins: an unbranded part with no maker's drawing). Its figures are community until measured, one from a related family and one an estimate: read each rule's text and measure yours. The lever travel is left out because no figure for it was found: measure it on your switch. kind as in x1c.json. Mounting face at z = 0.
name: endstop-10t85

body_width.rule: Case length, as sold; measure yours

body_depth.rule: Case thickness, as sold; measure yours

body_length.rule: Case height, as sold; measure yours

mount_hole_spacing.rule: Between the holes: the pitch usually given for this body size, not confirmed on any drawing of this switch; measure yours before cutting
mount_hole_spacing.source: no drawing of this switch found; measure yours

mount_hole_diameter.rule: Through the case, from the Omron SS family this body copies; measure yours
mount_hole_diameter.source: Omron SS subminiature basic switches as listed by a distributor, https://elcodis.com/parts/1819145/SS-5_p6.html

actuation_force.rule: Force to operate, at most: the 1.5 N (150 gf) code of the KW4A family, measured with no lever, and a lever lowers it; measure yours
actuation_force.source: KW4A micro switch series data sheet, https://p.globalsources.com/IMAGES/PDT/SPEC/456/K1055711456.pdf

rating_mark.rule: The mark moulded on the case: T85 is its temperature rating, 85 degrees C
rating_mark.source: KW4A micro switch series data sheet, https://p.globalsources.com/IMAGES/PDT/SPEC/456/K1055711456.pdf
